description: This file defines the ProjectResourceRepository class, which manages Android resource repositories for a module and its dependencies within the Android Studio IDE, including methods for creating, updating, and responding to project structure changes.

classes.name: ProjectResourceRepository
classes.description: Manages Android resource repositories for a project module and its dependencies, providing methods for creation, updating, and handling project structure changes.

methods.name: getProjectResources
methods.description: Retrieves the resource repository for a given module or AndroidFacet, optionally creating it if necessary.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ProjectResourceRepository instance for a given AndroidFacet, setting up listeners for Gradle sync events.

methods.name: computeRepositories
methods.description: Computes the list of resource repositories for a module and its dependencies.

methods.name: updateRoots
methods.description: Updates the resource roots based on current module dependencies.

methods.name: updateRoots
methods.description: Updates the resource roots with a specified list of resource directories, if they have changed.

methods.name: moduleRootsChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when module roots change in a project or module, refreshing resource repositories accordingly.
